cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4 && cat > /tmp/probe_dest.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "lib/lz4.h"
int main(int argc,char**argv){int n=argc>1?atoi(argv[1]):1000;int cap=argc>2?atoi(argv[2]):20;char pat=argc>3?argv[3][0]:'A';char *src=malloc(n),*dst=malloc(cap);memset(src,pat,n);fprintf(stderr,"dst=%p cap=%d end=%p\n",dst,cap,dst+cap);int consumed=n;int r=LZ4_compress_destSize(src,dst,&consumed,cap);fprintf(stderr,"n=%d cap=%d r=%d consumed=%d\n",n,cap,r,consumed);free(src);free(dst);return 0;}
EOF



gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DLZ4_DEBUG=7 -I. /tmp/probe_dest.c lib/lz4.c -o /tmp/probe_dest


for cap in $(seq 1 30); do ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 /tmp/probe_dest 1000 $cap >/tmp/o 2>&1; ec=$?; echo cap=$cap ec=$ec $(tail -1 /tmp/o); if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then cat /tmp/o | head -80; break; fi; done
